name: Fate Knock
description: Knock the foe at the moment their own fate leans toward a fall.

name: Two-Edged Luck
description: Hold luck that cuts both ways so that a blow aimed at the user may as easily wound the striker.

name: Doubling Step
description: Take a step along two fates at once and let the foe chase the wrong one.

name: Fate Glimpse
description: Glimpse the two likeliest fates of a moment and see which of them is nearer.

name: Fate Swap
description: Swap the luck of the user and the foe for one exchange so that the foe's good fortune turns bad.

name: Redirected Doom
description: Turn a doom aimed at the user onto an empty patch of ground beside them.

name: Burden Sharing
description: Share the weight of a hard fate with a willing ally so that both carry it lightly.

name: Doubled Misfortune
description: Lay two misfortunes on a single blow so that the foe is struck and then struck again by their own bad luck.

name: Fated Reprieve
description: Win a reprieve from fate by setting the harsher of two outcomes onto empty air and keeping the kinder.

name: Twin Doom
description: Cast the foe's doom twice over in a single stroke so that the same blow lands upon them from both of their fates.

name: Foreseen Jab
description: Jab at a spot a half breath before the foe arrives there.

name: Sighted Guard
description: Meet each blow with a guard raised a half breath before it comes.

name: Anticipating Pace
description: Pace out of the way of a stroke that has not been thrown yet.

name: Stroke Forecast
description: Forecast the next three strokes of one foe from the small signs in their shoulders.

name: Intercepting Blow
description: Strike into the path of the coming stroke at the moment it starts and break it apart.

name: Dread Omen
description: Show the foe an omen of their own defeat until fear slows their hands.

name: Certain Stroke
description: Thrust at the one point where fate has already placed the foe's undoing.

name: Prescient Ward
description: Raise a ward on every spot the next blow will touch and no other.

name: Decreed Blow
description: Decree the place and moment where the foe must stand and strike them there with a blow that cannot fall wide.

name: Skein Rap
description: Rap at the knot of the foe's skein so that their movements snag.

name: Tangled Cover
description: Spread a tangle of loose thread between the user and the foe that catches a blow.

name: Winding Step
description: Wind through the foe's guard in a loop that the foe cannot follow.

name: Skein Counting
description: Count the loops in the skein of the hour and learn how many turns remain before the fight is decided.

name: Wound Mend
description: Wind a mending thread through a cut on an ally or the self and draw the edges together.

name: Spindle Strike
description: Spin the fist like a spindle and strike so that the foe is wound off balance.

name: Skein Snarl
description: Snarl a skein of tangled fate round the foe's limbs so that each pull tightens it.

name: Restoring Thread
description: Pass a restoring thread through the deep wounds of an ally or the self and stitch the torn flesh whole.

name: Unwinding Doom
description: Unwind the skein over the foes so that a doom spreads out thread by thread and strikes each one in turn.

name: Unravelling Curse
description: Pull at the loose end of a curse laid on an ally or the self and unravel it until it falls away.

name: Sundered Skein
description: Sunder the great skein of the hour so that every thread that bound the foes to their purpose snaps at once and they reel.

name: Oath Knock
description: Knock with the force of a promise kept and land the blow where the oath was sworn.

name: Sworn Cover
description: Take cover under a sworn word that fate will honor against the first blow.

name: Snarefree Pace
description: Pace the ground in a way that has been promised free of any snare.

name: Vow Reading
description: Read how firmly a person is bound to a vow they have spoken.

name: Oath Snare
description: Bind the foe to the terms of the oath they swore so that they cannot leave the ground they pledged.

name: Kept Vow
description: Draw strength from a vow the user has kept so far and carry it into the next trial.

name: Vow Breaker
description: Weigh a broken vow on the foe who broke it until their strength flags under it.

name: Oath Reprisal
description: Strike a reckoning on a foe who has sworn and failed so that the blow lands with the weight of the broken oath.

name: Sworn Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of sworn vows that turns aside blows while the user holds to them.

name: Oath Decree
description: Decree the oath over the whole field so that every foe in it is held to the terms of the vow and cannot break from them while it stands.

name: Shear Cut
description: Cut at the thread between the foe's guard and their next move with a scissoring chop.

name: Snip Parry
description: Snip the line of a thrust with two crossing fingers and turn it aside.

name: Clip Step
description: Clip a short path through the foe's guard and step through it.

name: Sever Bond
description: Sever the bond between the foe's hand and their weapon for the space of a heartbeat.

name: Cut Loose
description: Cut away a binding or a clinging taint from an ally or the self by severing the thread that holds it.

name: Fate Clip
description: Clip a short length from the foe's fortune as the blow lands so that their next act goes awry.

name: Great Shears
description: Close great shears of qi on the foe and sever the thread of their balance in one clean cut.

name: Shearing Ward
description: Hold a ward of open shears that cuts the thread of every blow that falls on it.

name: Severing Shears
description: Cut the foe from their own fortune with a stroke that passes through every defense and leaves them bare to the next blow.

name: Final Rap
description: Rap once on the foe's guard in the manner of the last stroke of a long fight.

name: Dealt Guard
description: Take the guard that fate has dealt and hold it as if it were the only one.

name: Dealt Pace
description: Move the one pace that fate has dealt and no other.

name: Lot Foretell
description: Foretell which lot is the last to be drawn in the exchange to come.

name: Marked Lot
description: Mark the foe with the worst lot so that every chance they take runs against them.

name: Dealer's Hand
description: Steady the user's hand with the certainty that the last lot is still to come.

name: Black Lot
description: Draw the black lot and drive it into the foe as a heavy dark blow.

name: Doomed Lot
description: Hand the foe a doomed lot and strike at once to finish what it begins.

name: Turned Lot
description: Turn an ill lot back on the one who threw it and strike through the opening it leaves.

name: Final Lot
description: Cast the last lot of the fight into a single stroke that the foe cannot escape and that ends the exchange.
